messages.subject: Galaxy input file size limit?
messages.body_plain: My initial attempt to run MaAslin in Galaxy <http://huttenhower.sph.harvard.edu/galaxy/> failed. I then subset the data, 24.4 MB down to 12 MB, and it worked like a charm. Is there an input file size limit on Galaxy?

messages.body_plain:
I resolved this error by putting "sample" in cell 1,1 of my pcl matrix. Previously I had left it blank.

Nathan, it seems your pcl also has 1,1 blank.
